entry.name: dspstate~
entry.description: dspstate~ can be used for calculations that require the sampling rate of current DSP processing block size. You can also use the leftmost outlet to trigger some event when the audio is turned on or off.

messages.description: If a signal is connected to theobject's inlet,reports that signal's sampling rate and vector size, rather than the global sampling rate and signal vector size.
